description:
AIPedometer is a step and workout tracker with AI coaching that runs on your device. No account and no ads. Your health data is never sent to us or to third parties.

STEPS AND GOALS
• Daily steps, distance and goals with Apple Health
• History, streaks and achievements
• Wheelchair push tracking

WORKOUTS
• Workouts with Live Activities, saved back to Apple Health
• GPX routes and Expedition Mode

ON-DEVICE AI
• AI insights, Coach, training plans and smart reminders
• Runs on Apple's on-device model: health context used by AI is not sent to a cloud AI service

EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
• Apple Watch app and widgets

PRIVACY FIRST
• No account, sign-up or login
• No ads and no tracking
• Health data is never sent to us or to third parties

PREMIUM
Premium AI features, GPX route import and Expedition Mode require an auto-renewable subscription. Purchase, Restore Purchases and Manage Subscription are available in More > Support AI Pedometer. The optional Tip Jar is a separate one-time purchase.

AI features need an iPhone or iPad that supports Apple Intelligence, with it turned on. GPX routes and Expedition Mode work on every supported device. In English and Portuguese.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
promotionalText: Track steps, goals, and workouts with on-device AI coaching. Activity and health context stay on your device.
